tools.name: service_alerts
tools.description: Get currently active service alerts. Defaults to the TTC, optionally filtered by mode to subway, bus, streetcar, or accessibility alerts; the mode filter applies to TTC alerts only. Pass agency hsr for Hamilton HSR alerts, agency go for GO Transit and UP Express alerts, or agency all for every agenc

tools.name: route_vehicles
tools.description: Get live vehicle positions for one route from the agency GTFS Realtime vehicle positions feed. Pass agency to resolve the route inside one agency. For GO Transit the route can be a line short name or long name such as LW or Lakeshore West, a bus route number such as 41, or UP for UP Express trains.
